params.body:
Closes #659

R P3-1.1 and `docs/api/partner-api.md` said a partner gets a token from `POST api/token` with a user's password. That is the OAuth password grant, which Passport has left off since version 12, so the route answers 400 for it.

## What was measured
From 4 to 9 October 2026 partners made 16 655 calls to the partner API, about 10 700 of them on routes that need a token, without a single error (`stocklist_errors`, read on 9 October at 15:42). Partners have working tokens: the personal access token a dealer creates under Instellingen > Gebruikers. `api/token` writes nothing to `api_log`, so its own use was not measured.

## What is decided
No code changes.
- The route stays: Passport 13 always enables the refresh grant (`PassportServiceProvider`), so `api/token` renews a token with a refresh token, and a partner holding one would otherwise lose it.
- The password grant stays off: turning it on would first need `passport:hash`, and no partner needs it.
- The rule and the partner docs say this. The decision is recorded as `beslissingen/2026-10-09-api-token-zonder-wachtwoord.md`, and the finding is marked solved.

## Checks
Rules and findings tests pass (58); full suite locally: 3037 tests OK (2 skipped, 1 incomplete).
params.title: R P3-1.1 says how a partner gets a token: from the user screen, renewed through api/token
